column1: # Rows of the CLAUDE.md section 7 syntax table, made executable.
#   refused-check   the fragment must be rejected by `souc check`
#   accepted        the fragment checks clean (the row is style, not enforcement)
#   runs-halts      it checks AND the program stops where the row says it stops
#   runs-through    it checks AND execution continues past the construct
# Every row of the table needs an entry here. The gate fails if the counts drift.
